messages:
rachel: Quick follow-up from the inference-node OOM postmortem. We agreed to close the loop on runbook/playbook items: add memory checks, autoscaler guidance, and exact escalation steps for model rollouts. Can owners pick items?

tom: I'll take the node-level checks. Plan: add a 'pre-rollout memory sanity' section with commands and thresholds. Examples: `sysctl vm.overcommit_memory`, `free -m`, `cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.usage_in_bytes` and `journalctl -u node-inference | tail -n 200`. Will PR by Tue.

eric: I'll own the autoscaler/playbook piece. Need to document podResource requests/limits for common model sizes and the safe scaling window to avoid cascading OOMs. Will include safe defaults for 2x concurrency headroom and tie into Canary steps. ETA 10 days. Creating task INF-3387.

jo: Oncall runbook edits: I'll add explicit triage steps at the top of the inference runbook for latency/oom. Triage step list: 1) check `kubectl describe pod <pod>` for OOMKilled, 2) `kubectl logs --previous` for recent restart, 3) check replica counts and HPA status: `kubectl get hpa`. If memory pressure persists after 10m, page infra-primary and platform-eng. I'll include sample paging text and quick template for the triage Slack thread. PR tomorrow morning.

priya: We also need a playbook for rollback during model version deploys — include commands for reverting the deployment, how to force traffic to older model, and when to run `kubectl rollout undo`. I'll draft a safe rollback checklist (verify no partial traffic, confirm model checksum) and link to canary metrics we'll require before proceeding. Draft by Fri.

infra-bot: Created follow-up issues: INF-3387 (autoscaler playbook), INF-3388 (pre-rollout memory checks), INF-3389 (runbook triage). Marking postmortem follow-ups open.

rachel: Great. Capture owners and dates here: tom -> pre-rollout memory checks (PR by Tue, merge target Apr 3), eric -> autoscaler/playbook (writeup + defaults in 10d), jo -> oncall triage edits (PR tomorrow), priya -> rollback playbook (draft by Fri). If dates clash, reply here.

tom: For the memory checks I'll add a small helper script snippet that can be copied to incidents channel:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
POD=$1
kubectl exec -it $POD -- sh -c "free -m && cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.usage_in_bytes"
kubectl get --namespace inference deploy -o wide | grep '\$POD' || true
```

eric: Autoscaler note: we'll set HPA CPU target at 60% and memory target at 55% for model sizes >8GB, and add a cooldown of 180s. Will document recommended node types for large models (A100-80GB equiv). Also will add a line about pre-warming KV cache to reduce burst memory.

jo: Escalation path change: include names + pager contacts for platform on-call and model-serving SME. Add an explicit step to escalate to the deployment owner if rollout is >15m stuck.

priya: One more recurring pattern: OOM spikes often happen after high-concurrency traffic spikes post-release. Add an advisory to schedule canary traffic ramp slowly (10% -> 30% -> 60% over 15m) and include metric gating (latency P95 and container memory).

rachel: I'll update the postmortem doc with these owners and deadlines and link the PRs here as they land. Also let's add a 'lessons learned' blameless note template to speed postmortem capture.

infra-bot: Reminder: attach PR links to issues INF-3387..3389 to automatically close follow-ups when merged.

priya: tagging infra: please review the rollback checklist before I PR.

eric: happy to review, will check defaults against current autoscaler config.

rachel: thanks team — small but actionable. Please paste PR links here when ready. :rocket:
